digest.component_or_area: test harness — subprocess sentinel and network stall abort
propositions: Blanket autouse fixture applies 1s ACLI timeout to entire module, forcing five reap tests to wait ~1s each for deadline expiry, creating latent load flakes on slow runners.

Three reap tests assert on child-side setup (pidfile creation, spawn counter, partial stdout) whose ordering depends on 1s window exceeding interpreter startup — a wall-clock race lost on loaded hosts.
test_run_acli_429_retries_with_rate_limit_backoff inherits 1s ceiling as implicit pass condition (latent flake in opposite direction), because two sequential spawns must complete within it.
tight_stall fixture injects 2s low-speed window even though sibling dribble test proves git honors 1s, wasting test runtime.
Fake child processes must create readiness markers before hanging to make assertions race-free; wrapper must poll for markers before returning process so injected window is spent entirely on hang.
